6754704307.name: 1RM Calculator: Epley Formula
6754704307.description: 1RM CALCULATOR – YOUR STRENGTH TRAINING COMPANION Calculate your one-rep max instantly using the proven Epley formula. Get training percentages, and program workouts with confidence. FREE WEIGHTS CALCULATOR Enter your weight and reps for any barbell or dumbbell exercise. Get your estimated 1RM in seconds. BODYWEIGHT EXERCISES Calculate max capacity for pull-ups, dips, and other bodyweight movements—with or without added weight. PUSH-UP VARIATIONS Specialized calculations for elevated, standard, strict, and decline push-ups. INSTANT TRAINING PERCENTAGES Perfect for planning progressive overload. KG & LBS SUPPORT Switch between kilograms and pounds instantly. Great for international lifters or anyone who trains at different gyms. EPLEY FORMULA Uses the scientifically-backed formula: 1RM = weight × (1 + reps ÷ 30). Most accurate with 1-10 reps. CLEAN INTERFACE Simple, intuitive design. WORKS OFFLINE No internet required. Calculate anywhere, anytime. NO ADS, NO SUBSCRIPTIONS Pay once, own forever. No hidden costs. IDEAL FOR: Powerlifters planning training cycles CrossFit athletes tracking benchmark lifts Personal trainers working with clients Gym-goers following strength programs Anyone wanting to estimate max lifts safely WHY ESTIMATE YOUR 1RM? Testing your true one-rep max is taxing on your body and carries injury risk. By using submaximal weights (weights you can lift for 2-10 reps), you can accurately estimate your max without the strain. It's safer, smarter, and just as effective for programming your training. Download 1RM Calculator and take your strength training to the next level.

BODYWEIGHT EXERCISES Calculate max capacity for pull-ups, dips, and other bodyweight movements—with or without added weight. PUSH-UP VARIATIONS Specialized calculations for elevated, standard, strict, and decline push-ups. INSTANT TRAINING PERCENTAGES Perfect for planning progressive overload. KG & LBS SUPPORT Switch between kilograms and pounds instantly. Great for international lifters or anyone who trains at different gyms. EPLEY FORMULA Uses the scientifically-backed formula: 1RM = weight × (1 + reps ÷ 30). Most accurate with 1-10 reps. CLEAN INTERFACE Simple, intuitive design. WORKS OFFLINE No internet required. Calculate anywhere, anytime. NO ADS, NO SUBSCRIPTIONS Pay once, own forever. No hidden costs. IDEAL FOR: Powerlifters planning training cycles CrossFit athletes tracking benchmark lifts Personal trainers working with clients Gym-goers following strength programs Anyone wanting to estimate max lifts safely WHY ESTIMATE YOUR 1RM? Testing your true one-rep max is taxing on your body and carries injury risk. By using submaximal weights (weights you can lift for 2-10 reps), you can accurately estimate your max without the strain. It's safer, smarter, and just as effective for programming your training. Download 1RM Calculator and take your strength training to the next level.

6809662354.description: 把照片，变成想要收藏的小物。 用 POCKLO 将照片制作成火柴盒、邮票和照片卡，慢慢积攒属于自己的收藏。从旅行中的风景到清晨的一杯咖啡，为想要留住的瞬间赋予一个小小的形状。 每种小物，都有自己的相机 选择火柴盒、邮票或照片卡，相机外观和取景比例也会随之变化。可以直接拍摄，也可以从照片图库导入。 属于你的收藏架 拍摄后直接保存小物，为收藏夹自定义名称，再在 3D 中转动欣赏。翻到照片卡背面看看，或拉开火柴盒的抽屉。 按你的喜好装点手帐 自由摆放照片小物，加入贴纸和装饰胶带。挑选纸张样式，调整文字的字体、颜色、背景和边框。调整元素的前后层次，修改或隐藏默认文字，再一页页翻看自己的记录。 我的房间，收藏品的 3D 小天地 移动、抛出、堆叠你的小物。倾斜 iPhone，看看它们如何跟着一起移动。 把回忆放进每一天 在日历里查看当天的收藏，也可以用主屏幕小组件展示收藏品或手帐页面。 先保存在本机，再按需备份 收藏优先保存在设备上。你可以开启 iCloud 自动备份，或导出、恢复备份文件。删除的收藏品和页面会先进入废纸篓，方便找回。 完成的小物和页面可以作为图片分享。无需注册账号。 支持英语、韩语、西班牙语、巴西葡萄牙语、简体中文和繁体中文。 POCKLO Plus，给创意更多空间 三种相机、不限数量的照片小物保存、三页手帐和基础素材均可免费使用。选购 POCKLO Plus 后，可以创建不限数量的新页面，并使用更多封面、贴纸、装饰胶带、纸张和房间主题。 可选择按月或按年自动续订，也可一次购买终身使用权。各地区价格以 App 内显示为准。除非在当前订阅期结束前至少 24 小时取消，否则订阅将自动续订。费用通过 Apple 账户收取，你可以在 Apple 账户设置中管理或取消订阅。购买终身使用权不会自动取消已有订阅。订阅结束后，已完成的作品仍可查看、编辑和导出。 使用条款（Apple 标准 EULA）：https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/ 隐私政策：https://io-codyssey-pocklo.web.app/zh-Hans/privacy

6802260520.name: Cambler
6802260520.description: Cambler把易用的日常相机与需要时可用的专业控制装进同一个应用。 SHOOT保持画面简洁，让当下成为主角。选择镜头、完成构图并拍摄照片或视频，选定的风格会直接写入成片。 开启Y2K Mode，在现代4K文件中加入老式摄像机或早期便携数码相机的质感。还可选择日期与时间戳、Cambler标记或即时成像照片边框。 需要更多控制时，打开PRO。在同一个相机界面中调整ISO、快门角度、白平衡、帧率、编码格式、对焦、辅助线、峰值、斑马纹、伪色、示波器和音频监看。 五支镜头各有个性： 21 Field — 广角与暗角 28 Dawn — 柔和夜间光晕 35 Street — 日常默认镜头 50 Nocturne — 深暗旋转边缘 90 Portrait — 为人脸与远景而生 你也可以故意关闭防抖，拍出原始的手持视频质感。原片保存在设备本地，所选风格成为拍摄结果的一部分。 35 Street 和 Night 免费。Cambler Pro 按月订阅，解锁全部镜头、胶片和 PRO，可随时取消。 使用条款: https://cambler.vercel.app/zh-Hans/terms

6805060074.name: 司候 · 倒计时与纪念日
6805060074.trackName: 司候 · 倒计时与纪念日
6805060074.description: 司候把「还有多久」和「已经多久」放在同一张卡片上。 给它一个日子，它用「天」回答你：还有 124 天，或者已经 1,024 天。剩下的都让路。 倒数与正数，同一套模型 往后的：节日、假期、演唱会、考试、还款日 往前的：纪念日、宝宝出生第 N 天、戒烟第 N 天、入职满 N 年 需要精确时打开「精确到分」，副行给出「3 天 4 小时」，秒只在最后一小时出现 重复支持每年 / 每月 / 每周 / 每 N 天 / 农历每年 时区锁在事件上，飞一趟美国，圣诞倒数也不会莫名跳一天 倒数可选只算工作日 日期计算器：两个日子相差几天、往后加减多少天，算完一键存成事件 截图、照片或一段文字里的日期直接认出来，预填好新建 看得见走到哪了 倒数的进度条像电量条：实心是还剩多少，从满到空 正数的热力网格一格一格填满，一天堆一块 100 / 365 / 520 / 1000 / 1314 天的里程碑直接标在进度条上 环形、刻度条、热力网格自己挑，可按事件单独设，也可以只看数字 年视图一屏看完十二个月，哪个月最挤一眼就知道；月历视图按天排开 每年重复的事件标出「满 N 年」，倒数归零那天有一次小小的庆祝 提醒不迟到 每个事件可挂多条提醒：提前 N 天 / 周 / 月，几点响自己定 每日汇总：每天早上一条「今天和本周有什么」 进入最后 24 小时自动开启实时活动与灵动岛 重要的日子可以绕过专注模式 到处都在 主屏小组件：小 / 中 / 大，单事件、列表或图表三种取向 锁屏小组件：内联 / 圆形 / 矩形，各自可指定看哪一件 Apple Watch App 与表盘复杂功能：圆形 / 矩形 / 行内 / 边角 控制中心控件，一下新建 问 Siri「距离圣诞还有几天」，或在 Spotlight 里直接搜到事件 把一件事共享给家人朋友：你改了日期，对方那边跟着变 数据是你自己的 无需注册，没有账号 iPhone、iPad、Mac 之间走你自己的 iCloud 私有库同步，Apple Watch 由 iPhone 镜像过去 可从系统日历与通讯录生日导入，只读，不回写任何一条 全部数据可导出成一个 JSON 文件，随时导回；本机快照与「最近删除」，误删也能找回 App 锁：回到前台先过 Face ID / Touch ID / 密码 封面图与自动取色、六种低饱和主题色、分类、置顶、归档、分享卡片 支持简体中文、繁体中文、英文、日文、韩文、德文、西班牙文、葡萄牙文（巴西）、法文、意大利文、阿拉伯文、波斯文、希伯来文与泰文，日期与月份名跟着界面语言走 司候免费下载，免费最多保留 3 个事件；一次内购买断解锁无限事件。此前已下载过的用户永久保留完整功能，可用原 Apple 账户恢复购买。没有订阅，没有广告，没有追踪。 Cairn 是登山路上垒起来的石堆路标，走一段垒一块——标记方向，也标记走过的距离。

6738364976.name: Whois Master
6738364976.description: Whois Master is the fast, no-nonsense toolbox for anyone who works with domains, servers and networks. Look up who owns a domain, when it expires, where it points and whether its certificate is healthy — all from your iPhone, in seconds. DOMAIN WHOIS Registrar, creation, update and expiry dates Days until expiry, with a warning when a domain is about to lapse Domain age at a glance Name servers and status codes Works with hundreds of extensions, including .com, .net, .org, .io, .co, .me, .dev, .app and country domains such as .tr and .co.uk International (IDN) domains supported Paste a full URL and it is trimmed to the domain for you DNS LOOKUP A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, NS and TXT records Results grouped by record type and easy to scan SSL CERTIFICATE CHECKER Valid, expiring or expired at a glance, with the reason when something is wrong Issuer, subject, validity period and days remaining TLS version, HSTS and signature algorithm All domains covered by the certificate Serial number and SHA-256 fingerprint IP LOOKUP Your own public IP address, with one tap to copy Look up any IPv4 or IPv6 address Hostname, city, region, country, organization (ASN), postal code and time zone Location shown on a map BUILT FOR DAILY USE Long-press any value to copy it Clear error messages when a registry does not respond Full dark mode support Clean, native iOS design No account, no sign-up Whether you are a developer, system administrator, domain investor or just curious about a website, Whois Master gives you the answers without the clutter.

6753310758.name: Nomo Widgets
6753310758.description: One day at a time on your home screen. Nomo Widgets is a companion app for the popular Nomo - Sobriety Clocks app. You can quickly create a clock with your sobriety date and a color to be displayed as a widget on your home screen. If you're already a Nomo user and have the latest version, your clocks will automatically be on the list when you add a new widget. I hope this is helpful for everyone!

6800406873.name: 剪发展开图3D
6800406873.description: 动剪刀之前，先把脑海里的样子看清楚。 顺序和实际剪发一样。在头模上确定分区，定好提拉角度和长度，再加上重量让它落下。层次的叠合与轮廓，会变得容易想象。 ■ 取分区 头模分为5个区域、55个小区块：颈部、后头部、侧头部、后顶部、头顶部。点触选择，滑动可连续多选。每个区域都能切换显示，一次只专注一处。选择区域后，视角会移到最容易看清该处的角度。区域与区块的模型今后也会持续免费更新。 ■ 定长度与角度 提拉角度、前后方向、切口斜度。可以用操作面板调整，也可以用手指决定。与相邻区块长度一致时会有提示，可以刻意对齐，也可以刻意错开。也支持把头发集中到一点再剪的方式。定好长度和角度后，还能转动头模从各个方向确认。 ■ 让它落下 加上重力，可以看到头发带着重量往下落的过程。为了更容易想象实际的剪发效果，还加入了质感调整。加上质感后，发尾会不规则地变短，更接近真实的成品。 ■ 保存与比较 为设计取名保存，随时调出。数据只保存在您的设备中，不会发送到外部。即使时间不多，也能一点一点把您的设计做出来。 ■ 其他 ・左右对称显示的镜像模式 ・多种刘海选项（今后陆续更新） ・Night / SAKURA / Moon 三种配色模式 ・语言切换／English・中文・한국어・Español・日本語 ・无需联网。没有信号的地方也能正常使用 ■ 注意 本应用用于让想象更接近成品，并不保证完全一致。请将它作为尝试设计的工具使用。

6761699505.name: Smart Noise Detector
6761699505.description: Smart Noise Detector helps you capture sounds that stand out from the background. Start monitoring, let the app measure the room for three seconds, and it will record automatically when the sound crosses your chosen threshold. AUTOMATIC RECORDING Monitor relative sound levels in real time. Choose a threshold of +12, +18, or +24 dB above the ambient baseline. Save each sound event as a separate M4A file. Stop each recording after two seconds below the threshold. Recalibrate when your surroundings change. Continue monitoring with background audio support. FIND AND SHARE YOUR RECORDINGS Review recordings by date, time, and duration. Play a recording or tap Share to send the audio file through the iOS share sheet, use AirDrop, or save a copy to Files. Tap Select to choose several recordings or select all, then review the count before deleting. Canceling keeps your selection, and any recordings that cannot be deleted stay in the list so you can try again. ENGLISH AND KOREAN The app supports English and Korean, with English as the default for other device languages. YOUR RECORDINGS STAY WITH YOU Recordings are stored on your device and remain available when you update the app. NoiseDetector does not collect your recordings or upload them to a server. Audio leaves the app only when you choose to share it. Sound levels are relative to your device microphone and are not calibrated sound pressure measurements. Use the app to review everyday sounds, noise events, or barking while monitoring is active.

6758888554.name: Aerospace Toolbox
6758888554.description: Aerospace Toolbox – Professional Space Engineering Tools Aerospace Toolbox provides a comprehensive collection of calculators for space and aerospace engineering. Perfect for engineers, students, and space enthusiasts. Key Features: Orbital Mechanics & Mission Analysis Hohmann Transfer, Bi-elliptic Transfer, Lambert Transfer Delta-V Budget with phases and margins Orbital Elements (Keplerian, state vectors) Plane Change Analysis Propulsion Systems Engine Calculator (Isp, thrust, burn time) Tank Sizing Propulsion Comparison (chemical vs. electric) Thermal Design Radiation Equilibrium Orbit Scenarios (Eclipse, Hot/Cold Case) Structures & Materials Stress and Safety Factor Calculation Material Database (Aluminum, Titanium, CFRP) Communication Link Budget (Downlink) Free Space Path Loss Systems Engineering Mass Budget with Subsystems Launcher Capacity and Utilization The app works completely offline and requires no internet connection. All calculations are performed locally on your device. Available in German, English, and Russian. Aerospace Toolbox – Professionelle Raumfahrt-Tools für Ingenieure Die Aerospace Toolbox bietet eine umfassende Sammlung von Rechnern für die Raumfahrt- und Luftfahrtentwicklung. Perfekt für Ingenieure, Studenten und Raumfahrt-Enthusiasten. Hauptfunktionen: Orbitalmechanik & Mission Analysis Hohmann-Transfer, Bi-elliptischer Transfer, Lambert-Transfer Delta-V-Budget mit Phasen und Margen Bahnelemente (Kepler, Zustandsvektoren) Bahnneigungsänderung Antriebssysteme Triebwerksrechner (Isp, Schub, Brenndauer) Tankdimensionierung Antriebsvergleich (chemisch vs. elektrisch) Thermisches Design Strahlungsgleichgewicht Orbit-Szenarien (Eclipse, Hot/Cold Case) Struktur & Materialien Spannungs- und Sicherheitsfaktor-Berechnung Materialdatenbank (Aluminium, Titan, CFRP) Kommunikation Link-Budget (Downlink) Freiraum-Pfadverlust System Engineering Massebudget mit Subsystemen Trägerkapazität und Nutzungsgrad Die App funktioniert vollständig offline und benötigt keine Internetverbindung. Alle Berechnungen erfolgen lokal auf Ihrem Gerät. Verfügbar in Deutsch, Englisch und Russisch.

6753138603.name: PocketWise
6753138603.description: PocketWise - Making wise choices with your pocket money! Meet PocketWise, the friendly expense tracker born from a special mother-daughter collaboration! Created to help students navigate their first pocket money adventures, this app makes financial learning fun and empowering, and learn how to make wise choices with every dollar. Our Story PocketWise was lovingly crafted by a mother and daughter learning app development with AI together. We understand the importance of teaching money management early - that's why we built this app to help students track expenses, understand spending patterns, and develop the skill of making wise financial decisions from day one. Your Privacy Comes First We believe your financial data should belongs only to you. That's why: Everything stays securely on your device No cloud storage or external servers No data collection or tracking Absolutely no advertisements No sign-in or login required Personalize Your Experience Choose your favorite background colors Make money tracking feel personal and enjoyable Learn to Make Wiser Choices Weekly Overview: See daily spending patterns to make better choices Monthly Insights: Track how small decisions add up over time Visual Charts: Understand your habits at a glance Categories: See where your pocket money goes Build Better Money Habits PocketWise isn't just about tracking - it's about learning. Step by step, you'll discover: Where your money goes each week How small expenses add up over time The joy of watching your savings grow Smart decision-making with your pocket money Key Features: Simple, intuitive design perfect for students to update all transaction (both expenses and income) Offline functionality - use anywhere, anytime Secure local data storage - your data stays private Visual summaries that make wise choices obvious Customizable background themes No subscriptions or hidden costs Perfect For: Students receiving their first pocket money Young adults learning financial responsibility Families teaching money management skills Anyone wanting a private, ad-free expense tracker We'd love to hear how PocketWise helps you on your financial journey! Your feedback helps our mother-daughter team continue improving PocketWise for you. Start making wise choices with your pocket money today!

6763374462.name: CCIEPrep: CCIE Study Toolkit
6763374462.description: Prepare for the most prestigious networking credential in IT with CCIEPrep— a complete, expert-level study companion built for every current CCIE track. ALL 5 CCIE TRACKS IN ONE APP CCIEPrep is the study companion and working toolkit for CCIE candidates and the practicing network engineers who already work with these technologies every day. This is not a timed exam simulator. It's the kit you'll keep open during study sessions, change windows, and 2 AM bridge calls. Sample Questions 128 study questions across all five CCIE tracks — Enterprise Infrastructure, Security, Data Center, Service Provider, and Collaboration. Browse by track, difficulty, or topic. Tap any answer and the explanation appears immediately. No timer, no score percentage, no pass/fail verdict — just focused study material. Six Live Network Calculators Real interactive tools you'll use during a change window: IPv4 Subnet — network, broadcast, host range, mask, wildcard, class, private-space flag VLSM Splitter — type host counts, get an aligned packing of child blocks Supernet / CIDR Aggregator — collapse a list of prefixes into one covering supernet IPv6 Helper — expand, compress, classify scope, derive EUI-64 from a MAC MTU / MSS — choose a tunnel overhead profile (GRE, IPsec, DMVPN, VXLAN, PPPoE, MPLS), get the right MSS clamp Wildcard / Mask — three-way converter between prefix length, dotted mask, and ACL wildcard Every result has a Copy button. Drop the number straight into the CLI. Configuration Recipes A curated library of copy-paste configuration snippets organized by category: OSPF area baselines, iBGP route reflectors, EIGRP named-mode, prefix-list filtering, MSTP regions, LACP port-channels, port-security, IKEv2 site-to-site VPN, LLQ + CBWFQ QoS, NAT PAT, NTP with authentication, DHCP, WPA3 wireless, FlexConnect, NETCONF/YANG enable, Python Netmiko, Ansible playbooks. Troubleshooting Playbooks Interactive step-by-step decision trees for the situations that actually happen on production networks: OSPF neighbors stuck in EXSTART, BGP sessions that won't establish, STP convergence storms, IPsec tunnels up with no traffic, Wi-Fi association failures, and the perennial "the app is slow — is it the network?" investigation. Each step suggests a command you can run; tap your observation to advance. Daily Concept Cards One thoughtful, deeply technical networking concept per day, plus a full searchable archive. Why STP TCNs flush MAC tables. Why bit 7 of the EUI-64 gets flipped. PHP vs explicit-null in MPLS. Airtime fairness in Wi-Fi. Star the ones worth coming back to. Engineer's Journal A private, on-device change log. Tag entries (Change, Incident, Learning, Note), search the history, and build a personal record of what you did and what you learned. Persisted locally — no cloud, no account, no sync. Built for the work Universal iPhone + iPad with full portrait and landscape support Warm copper-on-slate dark interface — easy on the eyes during long sessions Every result is copyable All data stored locally on this device No ads, no tracking, no in-app purchases, no account required CCIEPrep is a study aid and reference toolkit. The sample questions help you check understanding; the calculators, recipes, playbooks, and journal are the same kit you'll keep using on the job after you pass.

6763368019.name: CCNP Enterprise Exam Toolkit
6763368019.description: CCNP Enterprise Exam Toolkit is the productivity workbench for engineers preparing for, and working with, Cisco enterprise networking. 6760903557.name: Blah Speech Trainer
6760903557.description: HOW IT WORKS Pick a random topic or enter your own Choose your speech length (1–7 minutes) Record your speech Get a detailed evaluation with scores, strengths, and areas to improve Read a coached rewrite of your speech with delivery annotations Practice the coached version as a teleprompter TOASTMASTERS-STYLE SCORING Scored across four categories (0–25 each): Speech Development, Effectiveness, Speech Value, and Voice. Includes filler word counting and timing penalties — just like a real contest. AI-POWERED COACHING Every evaluation includes a fully rewritten version of your speech with inline delivery cues: where to pause, slow down, emphasize, and build intensity. Practice it with the built-in teleprompter. WORD OF THE DAY Challenge yourself to weave a new word into each speech to expand your vocabulary. TRACK YOUR PROGRESS View your history, scores, streaks, and daily goals. Listen back to your recordings and compare transcripts. MULTILINGUAL Speak in English, Swedish, Spanish, French, German, or Latvian. All feedback is delivered in your chosen language. PRIVACY FIRST All data stays on your device. No accounts, no tracking, no ads. Audio is only sent for evaluation when you choose to.

6768932450.name: winnow
6768932450.description: Winnow is a task app that argues against the way task apps work. Most hand you infinite lists, no direction and no limits. Winnow gives you four main pages (year, month, week, day) with adjustable limits on each to restrain overcommitment. You set the year's ambitions, shape the month around them, build the week, and arrive at today with a clear picture of what to do. Forward motion, by design. The day itself has two parts: a pool of tasks built from your weekly intentions plus anything that needs doing, and a focus zone you pull them into deliberately. The rest waits. Anything unfinished rolls forward. Tomorrow is always a fresh start. Each task or intention can carry its own note, a private scratchpad that stays attached until you detach it. Loose notes dissolve after seven days. Bookmark the ones worth keeping, the rest clear quietly, taking any clutter with them. Link any task upward to the week, month or year, so perspective never gets lost. You're not just writing 500 words, you're finishing the book. Winnow is built around an opinion: that most productivity apps mistake feature volume for usefulness, and that what people actually need is a structure that resists overcommitment and reconnects daily work to longer-term ambition. One purchase. No subscription.

6791896861.name: Hevcly: HEVC to MP4
6791896861.description: iPhone video won't play on a PC, an older phone or a website upload? Hevcly re-encodes HEVC (H.265) video to H.264 MP4 — the format almost every player, browser and video editor can open. Pick a video from your Photos library and tap Convert to H.264. Hevcly re-encodes it on your iPhone, shows the codec and file size before and after, and hands you an MP4 to save or share. REAL H.264, EVERY TIME — video is always re-encoded to H.264 with AAC audio in an MP4 file, never just re-wrapped. Hevcly checks the finished file and tries another encoding route if it would still be HEVC. HDR TO SDR — HDR clips, which recent iPhones record by default, are converted to standard SDR colour so they don't look washed-out and grey on screens without HDR support. AUDIO KEPT — the soundtrack comes along as AAC. PREVIEW AND COMPARE — play the original and the converted video in the app, and see the source codec (HEVC, H.264, ProRes …) next to the new file size. SAVE OR SHARE — save the MP4 to Photos, save it to Files, or send it from the share sheet. BATCH CONVERT — select up to 50 videos and convert them in one go. Honest scope: videos are picked from your Photos library (not from Files). Output is up to 1080p — 4K videos are scaled down to 1080p — and the result is always SDR, so HDR is not kept. Everything happens on your iPhone. Nothing is uploaded and no account is needed. No ads. No subscription. No in-app purchases. Questions: overlapmarr@gmail.com

6796177924.name: Song2Cello
6796177924.description: 用耳朵听，用钢琴试，把旋律一步步写成自己的乐谱。 Song2Cello 为大提琴和小提琴练习提供手动记谱工作区。轻点钢琴键试音，选择时值并确认，音符就会显示在五线谱上，数字简谱同步排列。 主要功能 大提琴与小提琴各有独立草稿和撤销记录。 支持低音、次中音、中音和高音谱号，以及调号和八度调整。 输入单音、双音、休止符、附点时值、连线和泛音记号。 点选音符进行替换、删除或记号调整；支持撤销与重做。 回放当前乐谱，可从选中音符开始；配合节拍器练习。 书架保存与打开曲谱，草稿自动保存。 导出可打印的 PDF 乐谱，可选择显示数字简谱。 iPad 适合展开谱面操作；iPhone 提供横屏界面。 无需注册，记谱、回放和本地保存可离线使用。曲谱内容不会自动上传；正式版会发送故障诊断与随机安装标识，用于排查问题，详情见隐私政策。 本应用通过手动试音和确认完成记谱，不提供录音自动识别或自动转谱。

6759410596.name: Guitar Tap
6759410596.description: Guitar Tap turns your device into a precision tap-tone analyzer for guitar builders and tonewood enthusiasts. Tap a guitar body, a raw tonewood plate, or a brace, and Guitar Tap captures the ring-out, runs a 65,536-point FFT (about 0.67 Hz resolution), and shows you the resonant peaks that reveal how the structure and material behave. Built around the tap-tone workflow used by luthiers following Trevor Gore's methodology — but approachable enough for any builder curious about what their wood is telling them. THREE WAYS TO MEASURE Guitar mode — Identify the key structural resonances of a finished body: Air (Helmholtz), Top, Back, Dipole, and Ring modes. Each peak is labeled with its frequency, pitch, Q factor, and bandwidth. See the Tap Tone Ratio and ring-out decay time at a glance. Plate mode — Measure a rectangular tonewood blank with free-free bending taps. Guitar Tap derives Young's modulus along and across the grain, speed of sound, specific modulus, radiation ratio, and a quality grade — plus a Gore target thickness for your guitar's dimensions. Brace mode — A fast single-tap measurement of a brace strip's stiffness and quality. FEATURES Real-time spectrum that freezes automatically the instant a tap is detected Multi-tap averaging (2–10 taps) to cut noise, with per-tap comparison view Color-coded peak labels you can drag, toggle, and reclassify Compare 2–5 saved guitar measurements overlaid on one chart Save measurements with names and notes; export as files, spectrum images, or PDF reports Import and share measurements via the Files app, AirDrop, and more Microphone calibration support for measurement mics Spruce quality scale, anisotropy ratio, and density checks built in Play an audio file through the analyzer instead of the live mic PRIVACY Everything runs on your device. Guitar Tap has no accounts, no ads, no tracking, and never sends your audio or measurements anywhere. Works on iPhone, iPad, and Mac.

6794658617.name: 空瓶记
6794658617.description: 空瓶记是一款完全离线的个护与美妆使用事实记录工具，帮助你记录已经拥有的产品，而不是鼓励继续购买。 保存名称、品牌、分类、色号、开封日期、包装标示月数和原币种购买金额 从今日、产品快捷操作或详情页记录真实使用，并可编辑、删除和撤销 创建用尽或 no-buy 计划，进度只来自真实使用和空瓶记录 明确确认空瓶日期，保留时间线并可恢复误标 查看 30 天、90 天或全部时间的产品、使用、活跃天和空瓶计数 按币种分别显示购买事实，不换汇、不合计不同币种 导出文本、RFC 4180 CSV 或带校验和的完整 JSON 备份 导入前验证备份并预览合并或替换结果 核心记录、产品照片和计划只保存在当前设备。App 无账号、广告、分析、跟踪、云同步、订阅或 App 内购买。只有你主动提交反馈时，反馈正文、可选邮箱、所选截图、设备证明和必要诊断才会发送给 ApplyAI，用于回复和修复问题。 空瓶记只展示你亲自保存的事实，不估算剩余用量或完成日期，不作安全、保质期、护肤、医疗或购买建议。

6773636741.name: 宽心
6773636741.description: 宽心是一款轻量的心灵慰藉 App。你不需要立刻变好，只需要先宽心一点。 打开宽心，选一个你现在的状态——通用、焦虑、疲惫、迷茫、自我怀疑、睡前——它就会递给你一句真诚、温柔、不说教的话，帮你在情绪不舒服时，被一句话先接住。 【中英双语 256 条】 每条文案都有手写中文版 + 英文版，跟随系统语言自动切换，也可以在设置里手动选 英文不是机翻，是用英文母语者的语感重写过的——让两种语言下都是同样温柔 我们相信： 你不需要随时让别人满意。 你不必把所有可能的坏结果都提前承受一遍。 你不是不够好，只是暂时看不见自己的好。 宽心不是心理咨询，也不是白噪音 App。它的核心非常克制——256 条精心撰写的鼓励语，按 6 种心情分类，温柔陪你度过那些"先稳一稳"的时刻。 你可以用宽心来： 在焦虑的间隙收下一句安抚，把呼吸放慢三秒 累到怀疑自己的那天，被允许休息、被允许慢 睡不着反复想事的夜里，让今天画一个不完美的句号 把当下这句话保存成温柔的卡片，分享给同样需要的人 在桌面小组件上，让一句宽心话陪着你过每一天 陪伴你的角色「宽宽」是一只小小的猫，呼吸、眨眼、轻轻把信递给你。它不评判、不催促，只是说一句：我在这里。 宽心是离线优先的。所有文案、设置都只保存在你自己的手机里，不需要账号、不联网、没有广告、没有第三方追踪。 宽心提供日常鼓励、情绪安抚和心灵慰藉，不替代专业心理咨询、医疗诊断或治疗。如果你正在经历强烈的痛苦，请联系身边可信任的人，或拨打当地心理危机援助热线。 使用条款（Apple 标准 EULA）：https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

6793807191.name: KET指南和练习
6793807191.description: KET指南和练习面向 A2 Key（俗称 KET）备考，纯本地离线运行。无需注册、无需联网，打开即可练习。全部习题由设备端规则引擎即时生成，不是官方真题。 考试指南 提供考试概览、试卷结构与评分参考、报名与考场、备考规划等内容，支持关键词搜索，帮助快速建立考试认知。内容为备考信息整理，与剑桥官方无关。 专项练习 覆盖 13 类题型：听力选择、听力信息记录、听力图形选择；阅读理解、阅读匹配、判断正误；完形填空、开放填空、语法单选、词汇辨析；短句写作、长句写作、口语问答。 支持按语法考点、话题场景与难度自定义出题；也可一键使用语法强化、听力专项、阅读专项、词汇辨析、写作口语、混合冲刺等快捷练习。听读材料按 12 个话题分库，全库客观听读题 500 余道。客观题提交后显示正确率；写作与口语默认检查词数并提供自评清单与参考范文。在支持 Apple 智能的设备上，短句与长句写作可选用本地 AI 评价（仅设备端，不上传）。未完成练习可继续或删除。 限时模考 约 64 题、90 分钟完整模拟卷。本地练习量表 100 至 150 分，120 分为合格参考线。支持答题卡跳转、暂存续考、超时自动交卷与成绩报告。总分按客观题计分；写作与口语仅统计词数达标率。听力每题最多播放 2 遍。分数仅供自测，不代表正式成绩。 核心词汇 内置 600 余个原创 A2 高频词。可按 12 个话题筛选，支持背诵、听音识词、拼写测试、选词自测，并可标记生词。 错题本与学习档案 答错自动收录，相同题干合并；做对可标记掌握。支持筛选、重做原题与同类强化。学习档案汇总刷题量、学习时长、模考曲线、题型正确率与薄弱点。 离线语音与设置 听力和单词发音使用设备端英式英语（en-GB）语音合成，可调慢速或标准语速。不录音、不上传。可在「我的」调节字体大小与外观，并一键清空本地学习数据。 适合谁用 准备 A2 Key（KET）考试，希望利用碎片时间做指南学习、专项刷题、限时模考与词汇巩固的学习者。 隐私与安全 纯本地存储，零网络请求，无账号、无广告、无内购，不接入追踪或分析服务，不请求相机、麦克风、定位等敏感权限。 重要说明 本软件非剑桥官方出品，所有习题为本地模拟题，无官方授权，仅作备考练习使用。模考分数、练习结果与本地写作评价仅供参考，不代表正式考试成绩。写作与口语无法进行真人评分。报名、费用与考场安排请以官方及考试中心信息为准。 反馈与支持 应用反馈：请在 App Store 留下评价和反馈

6812873515.name: Chinois facile vocabulaire
6812873515.description: Apprenez le chinois mandarin à votre rythme avec plus de 7 600 cartes rédigées pour les francophones : vocabulaire, pinyin avec tons, sinogrammes et phrases du quotidien. TOUT LE VOCABULAIRE DU HSK 3.0 • Les 5 398 mots officiels des niveaux 1 à 6, classés par thèmes • Des examens blancs du HSK 1 au HSK 5, avec historique • Un lexique de plus de 7 700 entrées, avec recherche en français, en pinyin ou en caractères LES SINOGRAMMES, TRAIT PAR TRAIT • 1 218 caractères animés avec leur ordre des traits • Un cahier de calligraphie pour les tracer au doigt • Les composants de chaque caractère expliqués en français PARLER ET CONSTRUIRE DES PHRASES • 331 phrases organisées par actes de communication, d'après le programme de chinois du collège et du lycée (A1 à B2) • Un atelier des phrases : remettre les mots dans l'ordre, compléter, écrire sous la dictée • Plus de 880 mots supplémentaires classés par thèmes et par niveaux, de A1 à B2 QUATRE FAÇONS DE RÉVISER • Retourner la carte, comme avec de vraies fiches • Taper la réponse • Répondre en QCM • Écouter et reconnaître UNE MÉMORISATION INTELLIGENTE • Répétition espacée : chaque mot revient juste avant l'oubli • Mots à retravailler ciblés automatiquement • Favoris et cartes personnelles rangées dans vos dossiers, avec fiches imprimables SUIVEZ VOS PROGRÈS • Série de jours, objectif quotidien, badges • Statistiques de maîtrise par catégorie SIMPLE ET RESPECTUEUSE • Fonctionne entièrement hors-ligne • Aucun compte, aucune publicité, aucune donnée collectée • Prononciation par les voix chinoises de l'iPhone, vitesse réglable • Mode sombre et quatre styles visuels • Sauvegarde de votre progression dans l'app Fichiers Application indépendante, sans lien avec les organismes en charge du HSK ni avec le ministère de l'Éducation nationale.

6812612735.name: EO 投考全攻略 EOReady
6812612735.description: EO 投考全攻略把香港二級行政主任（EO II）備試拆成一條可以每日執行的路線：先確認資格，再練面試，最後以 JRE 與核心知識鞏固判斷力。教材離線提供，進度、筆記與錄音留在你的裝置。 主要功能： 投考路線：把由學歷確認、CRE、BLNST、遞交申請、JRE 到面試的 6 個里程碑變成清晰清單。 面試訓練：2,510 個離線面試情境，按自我介紹、時事分析和管理情境整理；可搜尋、收藏、標記弱項和錯題重溫。 口頭練習：每題 3 分鐘口答；可在獲得權限後錄音、回聽和查看裝置端逐字稿。語音辨識不是使用 App 的必要條件。 完整模擬：以六段時序、提示和計時，練習較接近完整面試的輸出節奏；可選擇錄音或只計時。 JRE 實戰中心：72 套 3 小時雙語練習卷；每套包括 C1 中文背景、E1–E5 英文 Data File、草稿自動保存、交卷前檢查和交卷後答案拆解。 知識與資格快測：用官方資料、職系攻略和資格題目打好基礎，再把閱讀轉成可交付的練習。 進度洞察：把練習紀錄、弱項、每日任務、實戰素材和準備度放在同一個本機儀表板。 雙語介面：可在繁體中文和英文之間切換。 EOReady 是獨立製作的備試工具，不是香港特別行政區政府官方應用程式。官方資料、招聘公告及實際考試要求以最新第一手公告為準。JRE 模擬個案、數據、答案拆解和準備度自評只供練習，不代表真實試題、官方評分或取錄保證。

6755234930.name: Algo Demo Pro
6755234930.description: 算法演示 Pro —— 算法与数据结构可视化学习助手 专为追求极致专注与完整体验的用户设计。算法演示 Pro 在保留原版所有强大交互功能的基础上，移除了全部广告，并默认解锁所有算法与高级内容，为您提供一个纯净、无障碍的沉浸式学习环境。 涵盖主题： 数据结构：链表、二叉树、栈、哈希表 核心算法：排序、双指针、动态规划、二分查找 Pro 版核心价值： 无广告体验：告别所有干扰，让您完全专注于算法逻辑本身。 完整内容解锁：所有算法演示默认可用，无需任何额外操作，即装即用。 核心交互功能： 精准进度控制：自由拖拽进度条，实时跳转至算法执行的任何一步。 实时代码联动：代码与动画步骤同步高亮，直观建立逻辑与实现的联系。 流畅动画与交互：逐步分解、速度调节、暂停回放，一应俱全。 投资于高效学习。选择 Pro，享受终极算法可视化工具。

6751784597.name: Yarimo - Goals & Habit Planner
6751784597.description: Why Yarimo? Yearly + Monthly Goals – Create big-picture goals for the year and instantly break them down into smaller monthly steps. One-Tap Assignment – Assign any yearly goal to a specific month with a single tap — no complicated setup. Swipe to Delete & Edit – Manage your goals quickly with simple gestures. Widgets for Quick Tracking – Stay motivated right from your Home Screen. See your monthly or yearly progress at a glance without opening the app. Stats & Insights – View your completion rates, track progress per category, and compare months to stay on pace. Dark Mode – A sleek, beautiful design that looks great day or night. Life Balance Categories – Organize goals into Health & Religion, Career & Finance, Relationships, and Fun for a balanced lifestyle.Yarimo – Year to Month Goals is not just another planner. It’s the first goal-tracking app built to connect your yearly goals with your daily and monthly life. Forget traditional paper planners or scattered notes Yarimo gives you one clear system to plan, track, and achieve everything that matters most. How it Works Add your yearly goals – Define what you want to achieve this year. Break them down monthly – Assign goals to the right month with one tap. Track daily progress – Tick off tasks, see completion bars, and stay motivated. Privacy Policy: https://sites.google.com/view/yarimopolicy/home Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

6787874695.name: 证件照秒拍-AI抠图换底色
6787874695.trackName: 证件照秒拍-AI抠图换底色
6787874695.description: 证件照秒拍是一款集证件照制作、AI智能抠图和PDF工具于一体的实用工具。不用排队去照相馆，用手机拍一张或从相册选一张照片，几秒钟就能得到符合规格的标准证件照，高清电子版可直接用于网上报名，也能排版后拿去冲印。 证件照一键制作 内置一寸、二寸、小一寸、大一寸等常用规格，以及美国护照、加拿大护照、英国护照、德国护照、申根签证等出国证件照尺寸。拍照或导入后自动识别人脸、自动裁剪居中，免去手动调整的麻烦。适用于身份证、驾驶证、社保卡、学信网、考研、公务员、教资、准考证、结婚登记、简历求职、港澳通行证等各类场景。 白底蓝底红底随心换 AI自动分离人像与背景，一键更换白底、蓝底、红底等官方常用底色，也可以自定义任意颜色和渐变背景。头发丝边缘自然过渡，没有生硬的白边和锯齿。 自然美颜与正装换装 提供磨皮、美白、提亮等自然美颜效果，让证件照更精神又不失真。内置多款正装西装衬衫模板，不用专门换衣服也能拍出正式的职业照和形象照。 合规智能检测 自动检查人脸比例、头部位置、居中程度和背景颜色，给出清晰的调整建议，帮你减少因照片不合格被退回的情况。 六寸冲印排版 支持六寸相纸四张版、八张版等多种排版，导出后可直接到冲印店打印，一张相纸搞定多张证件照，省时又省钱。 AI智能抠图 基于苹果原生视觉技术，人像抠图、物品抠图都能精准识别轮廓，复杂背景也能轻松分离。支持透明底导出、纯色背景、渐变背景和图案背景，还支

6794345479.name: PDF Ultra: PDF Reader & Voice
6794345479.description: PDF Ultra is a fast, elegant PDF reader for iPhone and iPad — built to make reading, listening to, and marking up documents feel effortless. It runs entirely on your device: no ads, no accounts, no tracking, and nothing ever leaves your iPhone. Whether you're studying a textbook, reviewing a report, or catching up on long documents hands-free, PDF Ultra keeps everything calm, focused, and beautifully native. READ YOUR WAY Day, Night and Sepia reading modes Continuous or single-page, vertical or horizontal scrolling Pinch and double-tap zoom, with a default zoom you choose Immersive reading mode and gentle auto-scroll Remembers your last page, reading progress and time LISTEN TO ANY PDF Natural read-aloud with true background audio Lock screen and Control Center playback controls Follow-along highlighting as each sentence is read Adjustable speed and voice, with auto-advance between pages Picks up exactly where you left off — even after relaunch FIND ANYTHING INSTANTLY Full-text search across the entire document Live results with match counts and next / previous In-page highlighting and recent-search history MARK IT UP Pen, highlighter and eraser with color palettes Undo, redo and clear Ink saves right into the PDF — and stays removable STAY ORGANIZED Library with Continue Reading, Favorites and All Files Sort by name, date or size Bookmarks and a tap-to-jump table of contents Open PDFs straight from Files, Mail, Safari and more Opens password-protected PDFs MADE FOR IPHONE & IPAD Universal, edge-to-edge layout with a roomy iPad sidebar Light, Dark and System themes with seven accent colors PRIVATE BY DESIGN PDF Ultra works fully offline. Your files stay on your device — there are no accounts to create and no data collection. Just open a PDF and start reading. No ads. No tracking.

6572327360.name: BirdSnap: AI Bird Identifier
6572327360.description: Identify 11,179 bird species from a photo — with no internet connection. BirdSnap runs entirely on your iPhone. No server, no account, no signal. Point your camera at a bird deep in a forest, out on a marsh, or halfway up a mountain trail, and get an answer in about a second. WORKS WHERE THE BIRDS ARE Cell service disappears exactly where birding gets good. BirdSnap doesn't care. Every identification happens on your device, so it works in airplane mode, deep inside a national park, or anywhere your signal gives out. 11,179 SPECIES WORLDWIDE Powered by BioCLIP, a biological vision model trained on more than 200 million images of living organisms. Covers the world's birds, not just your region — from a Northern Cardinal at the feeder to a Greater Flamingo on a salt lake. INSTANT AND PRIVATE Your photos never leave your phone. Nothing is uploaded, nothing is stored on a server, and there is no account to create. FIVE MATCHES, NOT ONE GUESS See the five most likely species, each with a confidence score, so you can judge a close call yourself — the kind you need when separating a Sharp-shinned Hawk from a Cooper's. YOUR SIGHTING HISTORY Every identification is saved with its photo and date, grouped by day, so you can look back on what you found across a season. No ads. No account. No tracking. Built by one person.

6819552936.name: GoTripMemo 旅行备忘录
6819552936.description: GoTripMemo — 把旅途中真正重要的信息，放在一个地方。 旅行，不该从一堆聊天记录、截图、邮件和文件里寻找下一步。 旅行备忘录 GoTripMemo，是一款为旅行前规划、旅行中提醒和旅行后整理而设计的离线旅行工具。 把航班、火车、汽车、船班、酒店、餐厅、景点、Checklist、图片、PDF 和重要备注，都整理在同一次旅行中。打开 App，就能快速看到当前最重要的信息和接下来的行程。 旅行前，你可以提前规划每天的交通、住宿、餐食和景点，并把需要携带的护照、签证、驾照等加入 Checklist。 旅行开始后，GoTripMemo 会把复杂的行程变得更简单。 下一班飞机几点？ 酒店什么时候入住？ 接机车辆是什么颜色？ 还有哪些东西没有准备？ 这些信息，都可以在需要的时候快速找到。 支持 iPhone 主屏幕小组件、锁屏信息和灵动岛，让下一项行程、旅行倒计时、今日计划和重要提醒始终保持在容易看到的位置。 Apple Watch 则可以在不方便拿出手机时，快速查看完整行程，并直接完成 Checklist。即使 iPhone 暂时不在身边，也依然可以查看已经同步到手表中的旅行信息。 图片和文件也不需要散落在不同 App 中。 机票、酒店确认单、接机车辆照片、门票、地图截图等资料，都可以直接加入对应的行程。图片可以从相册、备忘录等位置拖入 GoTripMemo，并在行程中直接查看。 每一次旅行都是一个独立的旅行文件。 通过 .Tmemo 文件，你可以把一整趟旅行分享给同行的人，包括行程、Checklist、附件和旅行安排。 个人证件的详细信息不会写入 .Tmemo。GoTripMemo 只记录例如“需要护照”“需要签证”这样的准备事项，而不是保存你的证件号码。 GoTripMemo 坚持本地优先设计： 无需账号。 无需登录。 无需云端服务器。 不收集用户数据。 没有广告。 你的旅行资料，属于你自己。 从计划下一次出发，到旅途中查看下一站，再到旅行结束后的整理与回顾。 Plan. Go. Remember.

6810107549.name: GeoCanvas
6810107549.description: 把圆的世界画成平面地图，总会扭曲一些东西：面积、形状、距离或方向。无法避免，只能选择放弃什么。GeoCanvas 让你亲眼看到这个选择。 在 55 种投影之间切换，转动地球，看清每种投影放弃了什么。 探索 常见的：墨卡托、罗宾森、温克尔三重、Equal Earth、摩尔威德、Natural Earth、阿尔伯斯 少见的：沃特曼蝴蝶、皮尔斯梅花形、Airocean、伯格豪斯星形、李氏四面体、分瓣摩尔威德 圆柱、伪圆柱、方位、圆锥、多面体和分瓣投影并排比较 旋转并重新定中心，看变形如何跟随视点 搜索任意地点，或用“我的位置”跳到你所在的地方 创作 矢量、栅格和地形图层，一张地图想加多少就加多少 轻点几下即可按类别或数值着色，附带现成色带 用参数化工具直接在地图上绘制 符号、标注和图例 等值线和地貌晕渲 导入 导入你自己的 GeoJSON 或压缩的 Shapefile 从 .prj 读取坐标系并自动转换，并如实说明转换精度 导出 PNG、JPEG、TIFF、SVG 和 GeoJSON 最高 A3、300 dpi 的打印尺寸，或自定尺寸 基于实测配置文件的 CMYK 分色，用于印刷 可去掉 geocanvas.app 标志，只保留数据来源 适合谁 向学生解释格陵兰岛为何没有非洲大的地理老师。试排版式的制图师。学生、记者、设计师，以及任何看着世界地图觉得哪里不对劲的人。 一次购买，无广告。可选：自动续期的 AI 月度订阅，可与地图助手进行更多、更长的对话。 GeoCanvas 使用开放数据，包括 Natural Earth。 使用条款（EULA）: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

6738010155.name: MindPass: App Blocker
6738010155.description: Learn something before you scroll. MindPass blocks the apps you choose. To use one, read a short fact and answer one quick question. Then the app unlocks for 5 minutes. TRY IT FIRST Start with a quick sample. Then pick your apps, your interests, and when to block: all day or on a schedule. 30 SHORT FACTS, WORKS OFFLINE Lava lamps help protect internet traffic. Tattoos last longer than the skin you shed. An angry customer’s complaint was kept on a clay tablet for nearly 4,000 years. MindPass comes with 30 facts on ten subjects, and they work offline. Some facts are just for reading. Others have one question about the idea, not about names and dates. Optional quizzes bring back some facts later. You can skip them. HOW UNLOCKING WORKS When you open a blocked app, you see the MindPass block screen. On iOS 26.5 or later, tap “Answer a question” to go to MindPass. On earlier versions, close the app and open MindPass from your Home Screen. Answer correctly to earn an unlock. Use it within 15 minutes, keep reading, or choose not to open the app at all. Your 5 minutes start when you use the unlock, not when you earn it. The time keeps running even if you leave the app. When time is up, the app is blocked again while your blocking schedule is on and Screen Time access stays turned on. STRICT MODE (OPTIONAL) Strict mode makes you wait 24 hours before you can turn it off or loosen your settings. You can make blocking stricter right away. Strict mode is off by default. Screen Time access can still be turned off in Settings. FREE AND PRO App blocking, schedules, strict mode, standard facts and unlocks are free. Optional MindPass Pro subscriptions add up to 10 personalized topics per UTC calendar month, with six facts per topic. Trial and paid access share the monthly topic allowance, with no rollover. Created topics remain readable after Pro ends. Prices and renewal terms are shown before purchase. Manage or cancel subscriptions in your Apple Account settings. GOOD TO KNOW Screen Time permission is required for app blocking. The interface and learning content are currently in English. Online learning features, including creating personalized topics, require an internet connection. Try your first fact.

6770800840.name: BillWitness
6770800840.description: KEEP A CLEAR RECORD OF MEDICAL BILLS BillWitness brings bills, EOBs, payments, line items and provider conversations into a private archive on your iPhone. Organize records across years, compare amounts and note questions to discuss with your provider or insurer. CHECK AND DOCUMENT Record CPT and HCPCS line items and flag possible billing inconsistencies. Compare bill, EOB and patient-payment amounts. Review possible duplicate charges across bills. Track dispute notes and independently verified reminder dates. Keep a communication history with contact names, hold times and outcomes. FREE FEATURES Start with one provider and up to ten bills. Attach photos or original PDFs to each bill; saved attachments appear in its supporting documents and your vault. Line items, EOB records, reconciliation, dispute tracking and communication logs remain available. App Lock, deadline reminders, complete ZIP backup and restore are free. Existing vault documents remain viewable and shareable without Pro. BILLWITNESS PRO Unlimited providers and bills Five PDF record packs for complaints, legal consultations, dispute records and tax preparation Scan and import documents, link them to bills or providers, and select originals for report bundles Choose an annual subscription or a one-time Lifetime purchase. Prices and any eligible trial appear in the app using Apple's current localized product information. Annual subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled in Apple Account subscriptions. Lifetime is a non-consumable purchase with no subscription. YOUR RECORDS STAY ON THIS PHONE No accounts, cloud sync, advertising, analytics or AI processing. Complete ZIP backups include structured records and original attachments. Older JSON backups restore records only. Save backups securely: they contain your personal information. Apple device backup remains available. BillWitness organizes personal records. Checks identify items to review, not confirmed errors or fraud. It does not provide medical, legal or tax advice, determine dispute eligibility, file complaints, contact providers or guarantee an outcome. Confirm deadlines and applicable rules with the relevant authority or a qualified adviser. Privacy: https://app-legal-pages.vercel.app/billwitness/privacy Terms: https://app-legal-pages.vercel.app/billwitness/terms Support: captainlongevity@gmail.com

6755983135.name: Goldweek - 黄金假期规划
6755983135.description: Goldweek 帮你找到在节假日和周末之间请哪几天假，才能休得最久。 不用再一页页翻日历计算，用最少的年假拼出最长假期的方案一目了然。 拼假推荐 针对每个即将到来的节假日，告诉你需要请几天假、可以连休几天。不会错过任何一次拼假机会。 42 个国家和地区的节假日 收录中国大陆、中国香港、中国台湾、日本、韩国，以及欧洲、美洲、中东、大洋洲等 42 个国家和地区的节假日，中国大陆还会标出调休补班日。节假日因州或地区而异的国家，可以选择你所在的地区。列表里没有的国家可以自己添加节假日，周末和一周的第一天也能自己选。 年假管理 总天数、已休天数和剩余天数在一个页面上清清楚楚。支持半天和四分之一天的假期记录，调休、奖励假等额外假期也能连同有效期一起管理。在日历上点一下日期即可登记或修改，还能从公司休假记录页面的照片中一次导入记录。 桌面小组件与备份 不用打开 App，在桌面小组件上就能看到剩余年假和即将到来的假期。记录会备份到 iCloud，也可以和家人共享休假安排。支持 iPhone 和 iPad。 今年的年假，别再白白浪费，好好地多休几天吧。

6801130306.name: BP Log: Track Blood Pressure
6801130306.description: I'm a preventive cardiologist. I keep meeting people who only learn their blood pressure is high after it has already affected their heart or kidneys. Home readings could have flagged it much sooner, if they're taken the right way. So BP Log walks you through the guideline method: two readings about a minute apart, averaged, because blood pressure shifts from minute to minute and a single number can mislead. It also shows your time in target next to your average, because an average can look fine while half your readings sit above goal. Dr. Kaustubh Dabhadkar GUIDED READINGS, DONE RIGHT Take two readings a minute apart. The app times it, chimes when your rest is up, and averages them for you Need more than two? Add extra readings and choose which ones to average, with every raw reading still saved Every reading classified against the current blood pressure categories the moment you log it STAYS IN SYNC Import your existing Apple Health history, then keep syncing automatically Log from Control Center, the Lock Screen, or Siri: "Hey Siri, log my blood pressure" Synced privately through your own iCloud account, never our servers BUILT FOR YOUR NEXT VISIT A clean report of your trends, with every morning and evening reading in a detailed log, ready to hand to your doctor Prefer to share less? A "Summary only" report shows averages and charts without the day-by-day readings Full raw history, exportable anytime A built-in orthostatic check for sitting-to-standing blood pressure drops Logging readings, your dashboard, the doctor visit report, orthostatic checks, and full history export are free, always. BP Log Lifetime (one payment, no subscription, ever) unlocks your full chart history, doctor reports covering up to 12 months, and orthostatic trends over time. BP Log is an educational tool and does not provide medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. Always follow your own physician's guidance.

6816436573.name: Memodo: Local AI Note Taker
6816436573.description: Speak naturally and the on-device AI understands what you meant, then creates the right item for you. Built for busy minds, students, and professionals who think faster than they type. ++ HIGHLIGHTS ++ No ads. No subscriptions. No account required. Speak freely and Memodo turns your voice into the right format. Meetings and lectures become clear summaries with key points and action items. Reminders are created with the date and time you mentioned, so nothing slips through the cracks. Checklists are grouped by category, so your grocery list is ready for the store. 100% local AI. Transcription and organization happen right on your iPhone, even in Airplane Mode. Your voice and notes never leave your device. No cloud, no sign-up. From your next meeting to your next grocery run, just say it and it's done. ++ DON'T BE A STRANGER ++ We have some exciting features coming soon, but you can always email suggestions or write a review for the app. Don't forget to share this app with a friend, because your support will make this app incredible. 6792239866.description: Notepad Calculator 是一款伪装成记事本的智能计算器。无需在计算器 App 和记事本 App 之间频繁切换，直接写下你的想法即可——每一行都会在文字旁边实时显示计算结果。 像思考一样书写数学 用自然语言输入算式，即可在同一行获取答案： 500 + 200 * 3 → 边输入边计算，无需点击等号 10 km in miles, 5 feet 6 inches + 8 in today + 3 weeks, Jan 1 2025 to Mar 1 2025 tax = 15%，之后可在下方任意位置复用 price + tax 8%、增值税（VAT）、小费、小计与总计，支持用 #tag 进行分类汇总 每个计算结果都会自动变为变量，方便后续引用，让多步骤计算依然清晰易读。 功能强大，完全离线 快速的本地引擎可处理丰富数学需求，无需网络、账号或 AI 参与： 函数：sqrt, sin, cos, tan, log, ln, exp, abs, round, max, min, pow 等 常数：pi, tau, phi, e 单位与换算：长度、重量、体积、时间、速度、温度、电学及自定义单位 货币换算：支持离线缓存汇率，并可通过“更新汇率”实时刷新 统计、百分比、进制与位运算（十六进制/二进制/八进制）、角度或弧度三角函数 中文大数支持（万 / 亿）及英文拼写数字（million, billion） 随心定制 全局定义页（Definition Sheet）：定义适用于所有文档的全局变量、自定义单位（如 1 box = 12 items）及自定义函数（f(x) = x * 2） 高效管理：支持文件夹整理、置顶、归档以及跨笔记全局搜索 排版清晰：使用标题（# 标题）、分隔线（---）和标签汇总让长笔记保持整洁 视觉个性化：可自定义结果栏背景色、对齐方式以及调整行间距 导出无忧：支持将任意笔记导出为 Markdown 或 CSV 格式 为 Mac 打造 菜单栏快捷计算：无需离开当前工作，即可从状态栏随时呼出快捷计算器 iCloud 同步：笔记与计算结果无缝同步至 iPhone 和 iPad 原生体验：支持 Native Mac 本地存储、自动保存，以及清晰的三栏式布局（侧边栏 · 编辑器 · 实时结果） 智能补全：单位、货币、函数及变量均支持自动补全 多语言支持：内置 10 种界面语言，支持实时切换 无论你是在估算项目预算、换算菜谱、规划行程，还是平摊账单，Notepad Calculator 都能将你的笔记变成动态表格——而且完全无需复杂的表格软件。

6744909217.name: AI Video Eraser
6744909217.description: Remove unwanted objects or text from your videos and achieve seamless, natural-looking results using advanced AI technology. This app solves a variety of video editing needs, including: Removing distractions from the background Erasing unwanted people or objects Cleaning up texts Fixing accidental appearances or visual noise It includes easy-to-use tools that help you track and remove objects with minimal effort: Object tool: Draw a circle around the object at any point in the video. AI will detect it for removal. Object tracking: Automatically tracks the selected object throughout the video using AI. Custom mask tracking: Define a rectangle or oval area to track any region across frames. Erase tool: Removes selected objects with AI and fills in the background for a smooth, consistent result. Whether you're editing short clips or full videos, this app helps you clean up your footage with ease and precision, no professional skills required.

6806592855.name: Network & System Admin Toolkit
6806592855.description: ForgeNetzwork is a complete Network & System Administration Toolkit for iOS and macOS. Designed for network engineers, system administrators, IT professionals, and students, it brings together powerful tools for subnet planning, network diagnostics, LAN analysis, and SSH system administration - all in one app, with no account or cloud dependency. SSH & SYSTEM ADMINISTRATION SSH Terminal - Connect directly to SSH-enabled systems with a full interactive shell Persistent Shell Sessions - Working directories, environment variables, and shell state persist just like in a native terminal ANSI Color Support - Display colored prompts, command output, and syntax highlighting Terminal Controls - Quick access to Tab, Esc, Ctrl+C, Ctrl+D, Ctrl+L, and arrow keys Hosts Manager - Save and organize multiple SSH hosts for quick access Command Reference - Search 40+ Unix/Linux commands with clear descriptions and one-tap copy Secure Direct Connections - SSH traffic goes directly between your device and the host you configure, with no third-party server in between SUBNET CALCULATOR & PLANNING Subnet Calculator - Compute network address, broadcast, host range, subnet mask, and wildcard from any IP/CIDR Subnet Splitter - Divide any network into equal subnets by prefix or count VLSM - Variable Length Subnet Masking for efficient IP allocation IP Range to CIDR - Convert arbitrary IP ranges to minimal CIDR notation Wildcard Calculator - Generate wildcard masks for ACLs and firewall rules Subnet Reference Table - Quick-reference chart for /8 through /32 prefixes Route Summarization - Aggregate multiple routes into a single summary prefix NETWORK DIAGNOSTICS Ping - ICMP echo with RTT statistics, packet loss, and min/avg/max reporting Traceroute - Visualize the full path to any host with per-hop latency Port Scanner - Probe common TCP ports on a target Network Monitor - Live dashboard tracking latency to multiple hosts with ISP information LAN & DEVICE DISCOVERY LAN Scanner - Discover devices on your local network with IP, hostname, and open port detection Wake on LAN - Send magic packets to wake compatible machines Network Info - View your current IP, gateway, DNS, and connection details DNS & WEB TOOLS DNS Benchmark Measure UDP latency to major DNS resolvers including Google, Cloudflare, Quad9, OpenDNS, AdGuard, and NextDNS DNS Lookup - Query A, AAAA, MX, TXT, CNAME, and other records for any domain WHOIS Lookup - Retrieve WHOIS information for domains and IP addresses SSL Inspector - Inspect TLS certificate details, expiration dates, and issuer chains for HTTPS hosts IP UTILITIES IP Converter - Convert IPv4 addresses between dotted-decimal, binary, and hexadecimal Calculation History - Review and re-run previous subnet calculations BUILT FOR IT PROFESSIONALS Native experience across iPhone, iPad, and macOS Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets for quick network status Optimized sidebar navigation for iPad and Mac Terminal accent color customization No account, no subscription, and no cloud dependency Available in English, Spanish,German and Simplified and Traditional Chinese. Whether you're administering systems over SSH, designing network architectures, troubleshooting connectivity, managing your local network, or studying networking and system administration, ForgeNetzwork puts the tools you need in one place.

6751835572.name: FinderHub - Orte in der Nähe
6751835572.description: FinderHub - der smarte Alltags-Assistent für deine Umgebung. Öffne die App, sieh sofort relevante Orte auf der Karte und starte mit einem Tipp die Navigation - wahlweise in Apple Maps oder Google Maps. Ob Supermarkt (Standard beim Start), Apotheke, Kita, Restaurant oder andere Kategorien: FinderHub zeigt dir schnell und übersichtlich, was jetzt in deiner Nähe zählt. Warum FinderHub? Sofort loslegen: Beim Start siehst du automatisch Supermärkte in deiner Nähe - nie wieder leere Karten. Suche nach Kategorien & Orten: Tippe z. B. „Apotheke“, „Kita“, „Restaurant“, „Bankautomat“ oder einen Straßennamen. Karte mit klaren Pins: Ergebnisse erscheinen direkt auf der Karte (MapKit) - präzise und gut sichtbar. 1-Tap Navigation: Route direkt in Apple Maps oder Google Maps öffnen. 6764438055.name: NoteQuick: Notas y Dictado IA
6764438055.description: ¿Cuántas ideas has perdido porque abrir tu app de notas era demasiado lento? NoteQuick nació para resolver exactamente eso. Abre la app. Escribe o habla. Listo. Tu idea está guardada. Sin carpetas. Sin etiquetas. Sin pasos innecesarios. Solo la captura más rápida que existe en iPhone. DICTA CON TU VOZ Toca el micrófono y habla. NoteQuick transcribe tus palabras en tiempo real. Ideal para cuando estás conduciendo, caminando o simplemente tienes las manos ocupadas. Y mientras dictas, la pantalla permanece activa. NoteQuick desactiva el bloqueo automático del iPhone mientras el micrófono está encendido, para que nunca pierdas el hilo. ESCRITURA INTELIGENTE CON APPLE INTELLIGENCE Tanto si dictas como si escribes, NoteQuick corrige tu texto en tiempo real. Separa palabras, añade comas, puntos y signos de interrogación automáticamente mientras pausas. Funciona completamente en tu dispositivo. Sin servidores. Sin conexión. Tu texto nunca sale del iPhone. DISPONIBLE EN 25 IDIOMAS NoteQuick detecta tu idioma automáticamente o puedes elegirlo manualmente desde Ajustes. La traducción de la interfaz funciona con Apple Translation, completamente on-device. Sin servidores externos. Sin comprometer tu privacidad. Inglés, Español, Alemán, Francés, Italiano, Portugués, Holandés, Sueco, Danés, Noruego, Finlandés, Polaco, Checo, Ruso, Ucraniano, Turco, Árabe, Hindi, Chino Simplificado, Chino Tradicional, Japonés, Coreano, Vietnamita y más. EDITOR DE TEXTO COMPLETO Selecciona cualquier palabra y dale formato al instante. Negrita, cursiva, subrayado, colores, tamaños, seis tipografías y alineación. Activa la vista cuaderno para escribir sobre líneas de guía, como en un diario de papel. SINCRONIZACIÓN iCLOUD Tus notas viajan contigo. Se sincronizan automáticamente entre iPhone, iPad y Mac sin configuración extra. CHECKLISTS INTERACTIVOS Escribe "- " al inicio de una línea y se convierte en tarea interactiva. Marca, tacha y sigue tu progreso desde la lista de notas. RECORDATORIOS Añade fecha y hora a cualquier nota. NoteQuick te avisa en el momento exacto. SIEMPRE VISIBLE EN TU PANTALLA Widget en home screen, lock screen y StandBy. Tu última nota o tu nota destacada, siempre a un vistazo. SIRI Y ATAJOS "Oye Siri, guardar nota en NoteQuick." Sin abrir la app. Sin desbloquear el iPhone. BÚSQUEDA Y FILTROS Filtra por tipo al instante: todas, listas, recordatorios, fijadas. Búsqueda en tiempo real. PERSONALIZACIÓN TOTAL 6 colores de acento, 3 tipografías, 3 fondos, 4 iconos alternativos. Modo claro y oscuro automático. EXPORTACIÓN PDF o TXT. Comparte por AirDrop, Mail o guarda en Archivos. PAGO ÚNICO. PARA SIEMPRE. Sin suscripciones. Sin planes. Sin trucos. Pagas una vez y NoteQuick es tuya para siempre, con todas las actualizaciones futuras incluidas. NoteQuick es para quien escribe ideas en servilletas, en la palma de la mano o en notas de voz que nunca vuelve a escuchar. Para quien quiere una app que simplemente funcione. Descárgala hoy.

6760935730.name: Cadrio
6760935730.description: Cadrio — iPad と iPhone のための、本格 2D CAD アプリ Cadrio は、製図・機械設計・建築アイデアスケッチ・部品図作成などに使える、iPad / iPhone 対応の高機能 2D CAD アプリです。AutoCAD / DraftSight などのデスクトップ CAD で慣れ親しんだ操作感を、タッチ操作に最適化したシンプルな UI で再現しています。 ■ 主な機能 直線・連続線・円・円弧・楕円・長方形・多角形・スプライン・ベジェ曲線などの作図ツール トリム / 延長 / オフセット / 回転 / 移動 / ミラー / スケール / 直線・円形パターン複製 角トリム / 角 R (フィレット)、補助線、ハッチング (パターン塗り) 寸法線 (距離・長さ・半径・直径・角度)、リーダー線、文字注記 レイヤー管理 (色・表示/非表示・ロック)、線種 (実線・破線・中心線・隠れ線・仮想線・一点鎖線・二点鎖線) ブロック (定義・参照・ライブラリ管理)、スケッチ拘束 (一致・水平・垂直・平行・直交・接線・同心・等長・固定 + 寸法拘束) 機構シミュレーション (運動拘束) — 固定・回転・連結・直動・平面・ピン・スロットの拘束を組み合わせ、駆動関数 (一定値・線形・正弦) でリアルタイムにブロックを動かせます。クランクやリンク機構の検証に スナップ (端点・中点・中心・交点・象限点・接点)、極座標トラッキング、スナップトラッキング DXF (R12 互換含む) 読み書き、独自バイナリ形式 (.cadrio) で完全保存、PDF レイアウト出力 iCloud Drive / Files アプリ連携で他デバイスや他アプリへシームレスに共有 画像配置 (JPG / PNG / GIF / TIFF / SVG) でトレース下絵にも対応 計算式入力対応の数値キーボード (＋ − × ÷ 括弧、マイナス値、編集中の値を消さずに上書き入力) 日本語・英語 UI 切り替え対応 ■ こんな方におすすめ 出先で素早く図面を確認・修正したい設計者・エンジニア 機構部品の動きを視覚的に検証したい機械エンジニア・学生 自宅で趣味の DIY / 木工 / 模型製作の図面を引きたい方 PC 用 CAD は重くて持ち運びに困るが、iPad の機動力で作業したい方 ■ 使用ライブラリ Box2D (Copyright © 2022 Erin Catto, MIT License) — 機構シミュレーションの物理ソルバーに使用しています。

6818188696.name: 不忘打卡
6818188696.description: 不忘打卡帮助你在合适的地点想起打卡。添加公司或其他常用打卡地后，可分别设置进入范围的上班提醒和离开范围的下班提醒。 主要功能 地图总览：查看当前位置、打卡地和提醒范围。 灵活设置：新增、编辑或删除打卡地，调整名称、位置与提醒半径。 双向提醒：为每个地点分别开启进入提醒和离开提醒。 快速打开：可选择列表中支持的打卡应用；收到通知后，点击即可尝试打开。也可以不设置打卡应用，仅接收提醒。 本地保存：打卡地配置保存在设备上，无需注册账号。 使用时请允许定位和通知，并建议开启“精确位置”。位置提醒由 iOS 系统监测，触发时间与实际边界可能受定位精度、设备状态和周围环境影响。不忘打卡只负责提醒及尝试打开所选应用，不会代替你完成打卡。

6804566503.name: Orgatami
6804566503.description: Orgatami 是 org-mode 文档的原生阅读与任务勾选工具。文件始终留在你自己的 Files / iCloud 里，没有账号，也没有我们的云。 当前可以： 打开单个 .org 文件，或授权整个文件夹作为工作区（下次启动自动恢复） 阅读大纲、强调、表格、代码块、列表、链接；尚未专门渲染的语法以原文行显示，不丢内容 点击 checkbox 勾选任务（含父级联动与进度 [n/m] / [p%]） 点击标题上的 TODO / DONE 徽章切换关键字 写回前检测外部修改，避免悄悄覆盖你在电脑上的改动 当前还不能： 改正文、插入标题或列表 撤销除「再点一次」以外的编辑 导出 HTML / PDF、agenda、小组件、快捷指令 适合已经在用 org 文件、希望在 iPad 上读和勾任务的人。完整编辑与导出按后续版本交付。

6444162098.name: Direkto
6444162098.description: Direkto is a Compass App. It can not only show where the north pole is, but also show the direction and distance to any other place. It also allows to record routes (of your travels, hikes etc) so you can follow them later again, or to find your way back more easily. The App shows a big compass which includes arrows showing the direction to all of the places you have stored within the App. You can also get coordinates and distances to these locations. There are two modes available for the compass: A more traditional mode where the center of the compass shows current the direction as cardinal points and in degrees in big letters, the second mode shows a map in the background which can display or record a route, which helps to follow the route or find your way back on that route. Just keep the path in the center while following the route. The App supports Live Activities (iOS 16.1 and later on the iPhone), so the compass and all the directions and distances to the saved places are always visible within the dynamic island (iPhone 14 Pro) and on the lock screen. The App supports Voice Over on the iPhone for blind and visually impaired users. The Watch App also shows the compass and all directions and distances to all saved places, just like the iPhone App. The App respects your privacy. There's no tracking, no ads, no hidden costs, no subscription. It's just doing what you expect: showing the direction to north and other places, help to find your way.

6761209781.name: Gravity Machine
6761209781.description: A tiny solar system that plays piano. Four orbs, a gravity well, and walls that ring like bells. Fling an orb and it falls, ricochets, and plays notes. Where it hits a wall decides what it plays; the physics decide when. You don't write the music. You build a small world and curate what it sings. Gravity is a touch instrument first. Grab an orb and it follows your finger; let go and the throw becomes its velocity. Drag the gravity well and every orbit in the room bends. Set Pulse and the well breathes in time with the tempo, so chaos starts keeping a schedule. EVERYTHING LANDS IN KEY Every impact point along the boundary maps to a note of the current scale, low at one end, high at the other. Pick from 16 scales and 11 tuning systems (12-TET, just intonation, maqam, shruti and more). The scale strip along the bottom is a key-change timeline: tap a segment, change the key, and the whole world modulates on the bar. EIGHT WORLDS TO BOUNCE IN Rectangle, circle, triangle, hexagon, pentagon, octagon, diamond, star. Sharp corners ricochet hard and play jagged. Round shapes glide and play smooth. SOUND A 16-voice pluck engine through a double-bass body and reverb. Octave, key range, quantize from 1/32 to 1/2, orb-to-orb collisions on or off. Presets to start from, themes for the visuals. AUv3 AND STANDALONE Use Gravity full-screen as a standalone instrument, or load it as an AUv3 in GarageBand, AUM, Logic Pro, Cubasis, Loopy Pro and any other Audio Unit host. Each orb has its own MIDI channel, so Gravity can drive other instruments in your host. ONE PRICE No account, no ads, no in-app purchases, no data collected. Buy it once and it's yours. The same engine ships as a VST3 and AU plugin for Windows and macOS at touchmachines.com.

6762347738.description: Track and manage your NeeDoh collection with ease! Browse the complete catalog of 56+ NeeDoh products by Schylling, mark items as Owned, Wanted, or Trading, and see your collection stats at a glance. 6795404742.name: Silent Bell: Mindful Taps
6795404742.description: The surprise that wakes your attention up. Silent Bell taps your wrist at random moments — a mindfulness bell for Apple Watch, silent by default. It divides each hour into equal stretches and places one tap at random inside each, so there is no rhythm to learn and nothing to brace for. Every tap arrives unrehearsed: spaced far enough apart to never feel like an alarm, unpredictable enough to keep working. Each one is a small, private question — where is your attention right now? SILENT BY DEFAULT, TRULY PRIVATE No banner. Nothing on your watch face. Nothing in Notification Center. The people around you will never know — there is nothing to see. Just a gentle tap, felt only by you, even with your wrist down and the screen dark. WORKS THROUGH EVERY FOCUS Because the taps are not notifications, Do Not Disturb, Sleep and Work Focus cannot silence them. Your iPhone can be in another room, or off entirely — Silent Bell runs on the watch alone. MADE TO GET OUT OF THE WAY 1 to 10 taps an hour, placed at random and never clustered A minimum gap, so two taps never land on top of each other Choose how the tap feels from eleven patterns. Tick, Double tick and Triple tick are always silent; the others only in Silent Mode. No account, no network, no analytics — there is no data to collect AN HONEST NOTE Apple limits how long any app may run in the background to one hour. When Silent Bell reaches that limit it pauses, gives you a distinct pattern you'll learn to recognise, and one tap resumes it. It is a platform limit rather than a choice, and it makes a fair bell of its own: once an hour you notice that the noticing stopped, and you choose to begin again. REQUIRES Apple Watch with watchOS 10 or later. There is no iPhone app to install. The source code is public and auditable at github.com/jakublipinski/Silent-Bell — every line the app runs, readable by anyone.

WORKS THROUGH EVERY FOCUS Because the taps are not notifications, Do Not Disturb, Sleep and Work Focus cannot silence them. Your iPhone can be in another room, or off entirely — Silent Bell runs on the watch alone. MADE TO GET OUT OF THE WAY 1 to 10 taps an hour, placed at random and never clustered A minimum gap, so two taps never land on top of each other Choose how the tap feels from eleven patterns. Tick, Double tick and Triple tick are always silent; the others only in Silent Mode. No account, no network, no analytics — there is no data to collect AN HONEST NOTE Apple limits how long any app may run in the background to one hour. When Silent Bell reaches that limit it pauses, gives you a distinct pattern you'll learn to recognise, and one tap resumes it. It is a platform limit rather than a choice, and it makes a fair bell of its own: once an hour you notice that the noticing stopped, and you choose to begin again. REQUIRES Apple Watch with watchOS 10 or later. There is no iPhone app to install. The source code is public and auditable at github.com/jakublipinski/Silent-Bell — every line the app runs, readable by anyone.

6745276008.name: Vox libri
6745276008.description: Read your way: accessible, comfortable, and without barriers. Vox Libri is designed to help anyone read books and documents in a flexible, personalized, and fully accessible way. Whether you prefer reading on screen, using a braille display, or listening with high-quality text-to-speech, enjoying your content has never been easier. Lightweight, fast, and built for readers who want a comfortable, distraction-free, and inclusive reading experience. Key Features High-quality text-to-speech for natural and expressive read-aloud. This application uses the voices installed on your device. Braille reading mode, fully compatible with braille displays. Customizable reading screen with adjustable font, size, colors, spacing, and themes. Support for major document formats, including TXT, PDF, DOCX, RTF, HTML, Markdown, and EPUB. Fully accessible interface, optimized for blind users, low-vision users, and people with reading difficulties. Smart navigation through chapters, headings, pages, bookmarks, and document sections. Hands-free reading via headphone controls. On-device AI translation, summarization, and simplification when supported by the device. Full Spanish, English, Italian, French and Greek support across the interface and reading experience. Vox Libri is perfect for people with dyslexia, low vision, braille users, students, professionals, or anyone who wants a more comfortable and customizable reading experience. Carry your entire library with you and read however you prefer.

6784252840.name: BioStat Lab
6784252840.description: BioStat Lab 是专为生物医学研究者、临床医生和学生设计的专业统计效能与样本量计算工具，完全离线运行。 功能模块 t 检验 — 独立样本与配对 计算独立样本或配对 t 检验所需样本量。输入均值差、标准差、显著性水平 (α) 和目标效能 (1−β)。 ANOVA — 单因素方差分析 计算 2–20 组单因素 ANOVA 的每组及总样本量，采用 Bonferroni 校正控制多重比较误差。 比例检验 — 双比例 z 检验 比较两组事件率或响应比例，同步显示绝对差与风险比。 相关系数 — Pearson r 基于 Fisher z 变换，计算检验 Pearson 相关系数是否显著异于零所需样本量，附 Cohen 效应量分级。 生存分析 — 对数秩检验 使用 Freedman 公式，输入风险比、预期事件率、α 和效能，输出所需事件数与受试者总数。 设计理念 深空风格界面，深靛蓝底色配紫色数字显示，等宽字体读数，专注科研场景。 隐私 无需注册，不收集任何数据，所有计算均在本地完成。

6757694773.description: QuickScan - 智能证件扫描与管理平台 【核心功能】 智能扫描识别 一键扫描身份证、银行卡、驾驶证、学生证、工作证、户口本、营业执照等各类证件和文档。采用先进的AI视觉识别技术，自动检测文档边缘，智能矫正角度和透视，确保每一次扫描都清晰准确。无论光线如何，都能捕捉最佳效果。 本地加密存储 所有扫描数据都存储在你的设备上，采用端到端加密技术，永远不会上传到云端或第三方服务器。你的隐私完全掌握在自己手中。支持Face ID和Touch ID生物识别解锁，多重安全防护确保证件信息安全无忧。 灵活导出分享 支持导出为高质量PDF文档，完美保留原始细节。升级Pro会员后，还可导出为Word文档，方便编辑和整理。一键分享到邮件、消息、云盘等应用，让证件传递变得简单高效。 智能图像处理 内置多种滤镜和处理工具，包括增强、黑白、灰度、锐化、智能高清等。支持自由旋转、裁剪，让每一张扫描件都达到最佳呈现效果。一键还原原图，随时撤销操作。 证件分类管理 按证件类型自动分类，支持按归属（本人、家人、其他）进行组织。快速搜索功能让你瞬间找到需要的证件。收藏常用证件，优先显示在首页。 【Pro会员专享】 自定义水印 为导出的长图添加个性化水印，保护你的证件信息。支持自定义文字内容，灵活调整透明度和位置。 家人证件管理 为家人创建独立的证件空间，安全存储家人的身份证、护照等重要证件。支持多人管理，权限清晰。 高级导出功能 导出为Word文档，保留完整格式，方便后续编辑和使用。生成长图功能，将多页文档合并为一张长图，分享更便捷。 去除水印 移除系统默认水印，导出纯净的证件图片。 【使用场景】 日常证件管理 随身携带重要证件的数字副本，无需担心遗失或损坏。需要时快速查找，一键分享。 金融服务申请 申请贷款、开户、保险等服务时，快速导出证件副本，提高办理效率。 旅行出行 出国旅游前扫描护照、签证等重要文件，备份在手机中。遇到紧急情况可快速提供证明。 工作办公 扫描合同、营业执照等工作文件，方便团队协作和存档。支持批量导出，提高工作效率。 【技术特点】 先进的AI识别 采用深度学习算法，精准识别各类证件信息，识别准确率超过95%。 高效的图像处理 优化的算法确保快速处理，即使是大量文件也能流畅运行。 隐私优先设计 所有处理都在本地完成，不依赖云端服务，完全保护你的隐私。 流畅的用户体验 简洁直观的界面设计，符合iOS设计规范。快速响应，零延迟操作。 【订阅计划】 免费版 无限扫描 基础图像处理 本地存储 PDF导出 月度订阅 ¥3/月 所有免费功能 Word导出 自定义水印 家人证件管理 3天免费试用 永久会员 ¥12一次性 所有功能永久解锁 一次购买，终身使用 无需续费，无隐藏费用 【用户评价】 "终于找到一个真正保护隐私的扫描应用。数据都在本地，我很放心。" "界面简洁，功能强大。扫描效果比我想象的还要好。" "导出Word功能太方便了，工作效率提高了不少。" 【隐私与安全】 QuickScan严格遵守Apple隐私政策。我们不收集、不存储、不分享任何用户数据。所有扫描内容完全由你控制，永远不会被用于任何商业目的。 支持Face ID和Touch ID，为你的证件信息增加一层生物识别保护。 【系统要求】 iOS 15.0或更高版本 iPhone、iPad兼容 需要相机权限用于扫描 【联系我们】 如有任何问题或建议，欢迎通过以下方式联系： 应用内反馈：设置 > 意见反馈 邮箱：3501485935@qq.com 感谢你选择，让我们一起让证件管理变得更简单、更安全、更智能。 隐私政策：https://mcnzv1vkrtox.feishu.cn/wiki/E3JXw28rWie0IXkrojscVofnnYf?from=from_copylink 使用条款：https://mcnzv1vkrtox.feishu.cn/wiki/E3JXw28rWie0IXkrojscVofnnYf?from=from_copylink

6761154119.name: PDFix：文档图片编辑手写签名扫描文件阅读转换器全能王
6761154119.trackName: PDFix：文档图片编辑手写签名扫描文件阅读转换器全能王
6761154119.description: PDFix 是一款本地优先的 PDF 工具，适合学习、办公和日常文档处理。你可以导入 PDF 或图片，扫描纸质文件并建立 OCR 文本索引，在一个工作区中完成搜索、阅读与整理。 在 PDFix 中，你可以高亮、下划线、批注、替换文字、添加文本框、应用签名与图章，并通过旋转、拆分、导出图片等页面工具快速整理文档。常用的格式转换也能一站完成，包括图片转 PDF、提取纯文本，以及 PDF 与 Word、Excel、PPT 之间的互转。 PDFix 还提供模板中心，帮助你更快开始简历、笔记纸、待办清单和常见办公文档。重要文件优先保留在本地工作区中，减少来回切换应用的麻烦，也更适合注重隐私与效率的日常使用。 隐私政策：https://mcnzv1vkrtox.feishu.cn/wiki/I5F2w6YiSi9a9UkNGmNcZxNbn7w?from=from_copylink 使用条款：https://mcnzv1vkrtox.feishu.cn/wiki/KmLYwvpB4iFeY4kcmgecXRx8nEe?from=from_copylink

6780601344.name: 收款收据本地版2026
6780601344.description: 收据本是一款面向小微商户、自由职业者、工作室和行政财务人员的本地收款收据管理工具。无需登录、无需联网，所有收据、客户、项目和凭证照片都保存在本机。 适合用于定金收据、租金收据、培训收费、服务费收款、样品费、材料费、押金收取等场景。用户可以快速填写付款方、收款项目、金额、收款方式、经办人和备注，自动生成大写金额与连续编号，并导出 PDF 便于打印或发送。 主要功能： 1. 收据编辑：支持付款方、收款方、收款项目、金额、收款方式、经办人、备注等字段。 2. 金额大写：输入数字金额后自动转换中文大写，减少手写和录入错误。 3. 编号归档：按日期、客户、项目自动保存收据，支持编号搜索和状态标记。 4. 模板复用：常用收款项目、收款方信息、备注条款可保存为模板。 5. PDF导出：生成适合打印和分享的收据 PDF，支持本地预览与导出。 6. 本地安全：不需要账号、不联网、不上传任何收据信息。

6800564890.description: 息影 是一款专为运动和长时间录制场景设计的视频记录工具，让你的精彩瞬间完整留存。 核心功能： 【熄屏省电录制】 录制时自动进入熄屏状态，大幅降低屏幕功耗，显著延长录制时长。骑行、跑步等长时间运动场景下，手机续航更持久，记录更完整。 【语音智能控制】 运动中无需手动操作。启用语音控制后，说出预设命令即可开始录制、停止录制或拍照。支持自定义命令词，骑行、滑板中也能轻松操控。 【专业录制参数】 支持高清画质调节、多种帧率选择、运动防抖功能。闪光灯、前后摄像头、缩放倍率自由切换，满足不同运动场景的录制需求。 【智能分段保存】 长时间运动录制时，视频自动按设定时长分割保存。方便后期整理与分享，避免单个文件过大难以处理。 【定时与电量保护】 设定录制时长，到时自动停止保存。低电量时智能提醒并自动保存录制内容，避免运动中断电导致数据丢失。 【桌面三脚架模式】 支持桌面三脚架固定录制，适合会议记录、网课学习、手作演示等场景。熄屏模式保护隐私，录制更专业。 适用场景： 骑行、摩托车运动记录 跑步、滑板、轮滑记录 户外徒步与登山记录 会议纪要与网课学习 手作演示与桌面录制 日常生活vlog记录 我们致力于提供专业、稳定、省电的录制体验，让每一次精彩时刻都被完整记录。 如有问题或建议，欢迎通过App Store联系我们反馈。 重要说明： 1.本应用仅供合法用途使用，用户须遵守当地法律法规，不得用于侵犯他人隐私或任何违法活动。 2.用户应自行承担使用本应用所产生的一切法律责任。 3.未经他人同意在私人场所进行录制可能违反当地法律，请确保在合法范围内使用。 4.因系统故障、电量耗尽等原因导致录制中断或数据丢失，开发者不承担责任。 5.请合理使用本应用，尊重他人隐私权和肖像权。

6818409283.description: 用拾光待办安排日常任务、专注时间和重要日子，让每天要做的事更清晰。 【待办与日程】 按日期和分类整理任务，设置优先级、子任务及重复规则。 查看今日、最近待办和待办箱，配置本地提醒。 任务保存在设备上，核心待办功能离线可用。 【专注与重要日子】 番茄时钟支持专注与休息切换、计时恢复和本机完成记录。 重要日子支持公历、农历、重复和提醒。 可选邮箱提醒需登录并验证邮箱，免费支持 3 个事件；可随时取消。 【Apple 平台同步】 在服务可用时，通过 Apple 的 iCloud 私有数据库同步任务和重要日子。iCloud 同步需要系统 Apple 账户、相关 iCloud 设置及网络连接，实际可用性取决于 Apple 服务和设备设置。番茄完成记录保存在本机。 【隐私与反馈】 核心待办无需注册应用账号，无广告追踪。诊断默认关闭，可主动开启脱敏诊断或提交技术反馈，帮助定位故障。邮箱提醒仅在主动启用后处理所需信息，详见隐私政策。 本地提醒需要通知授权。当前版本无应用内购买或订阅。

6445799825.name: That Checklist
6445799825.description: That Checklist allows for quick data entry into text fields and mark-off of checkboxes. Group checklists content into navigable entries to easily organize content. Click on a Nav Item to bring up previous checklists fast. Edit or reorder content using built-in context menus. Checklists can be shifted left/right to simulate a parent/child tree-like structure. A powerful Filter field allows for fast filtering of content. Filtering can be toggled between filtering by checklist text entry or Tree name. Features: Editable navigation items. Stellar tree view to organize complex checklists. Great looking checklists that can be indented to form parent/child structures. Instructions for app use: 1.) Launch app. 2.) Click + icon to create a new Navigation Item (Nav Item). 3.) Enter in a Nav Item name. 4.) Click newly created nav item. 5.) Main view loads. Click + icon in upper right to add new Tree Item. When pop up shows, enter a name. 6.) Click newly created Tree Item’s + icon. This creates checklist for data entry. 7.) Type data into text fields. It auto saves content. Click the checkbox to check-off items like a checklist. 8.) Click move left/right arrows to adjust indent. 9.) Click ( - minus) icon to delete a checklist. If text field has data, there will be a confirmation pop-up. If no data, the field is just removed. 10.) Tap-hold on checklist checkbox or the buttons to right for context options. For example tap-holding on minus (-) button will show more options. 10.1) Tap-hold options: Insert New Text Above/Below will insert a new checklist either above current tap-hold location or below. Indentation of inserted items will match current indent of currently tap-hold item. 10.2) Reorder will show a pop-up view where user can drag/drop entries around in whichever desired order is wanted. 11.) Toolbar Reorder button will perform a similar task as the checklist Reorder; although it will only show Tree items in list and they will be reordered to desired order. 12.) Toolbar chevrons for collapse all and expand all, this affects only Tree items under current Navigation item - unless using the "All Items" navigation, then all Tree Items for all Navigation Items will either expand or collapse. 13.) Tap-hold context options for Navigation items for editing Nav Item name, Reordering list, or deleting. 14.) Filter field at bottom left of main view - clicking the filter icon will cycle between either filtering by Text data or by Tree Item name. Toggle icon to appropriate choice and type into filter field. Data is dynamically filtered. Be sure to clear the filter when complete - changing to another Navigation item keeps the Filter text and will still actively attempt to filter content. Use Examples: Verify the packing of camping supplies. Create to do lists for chores. List out your reminders. Document completion of work tasks.

6801866888.name: 上次是什么时候 - 家务·保养记录
6801866888.trackName: 上次是什么时候 - 家务·保养记录
6801866888.description: 别再管理待办了。只要记住上次做的日期就够了。 "床单上次是什么时候洗的？" "净水器滤芯什么时候换的？" "上次给爸妈打电话是哪天？" 总有一些事，怎么也想不起来。啥时候做的 只记录你做这件事的日期。 没有目标，没有轰炸式提醒，没有清单。点一下记为今天，就完成了。 ■ 过了多久，一眼看清 每一项都显示距上次做过了几天。 拖得越久，越显眼。 ■ 时间间隔原样呈现的记录 点与点之间的距离，就是真实的日期间隔。 常做的时期看起来很密，很久没做的那段会空出一大片。 ■ 照片和备注 每条记录可以附一张照片和一句备注。 "那时候是什么样"也一起留下。 ■ 小组件和锁定屏幕 在主屏幕小组件上查看拖延的事项，不打开 App 也能记录。 也可以直接在锁定屏幕上记录。（iOS 16.4 及以上） ■ 每日收尾提醒 如果需要，晚上会问一次"今天做了什么？"。默认关闭。 ■ 完全本地 没有账号、没有服务器、没有广告。记录只保存在你的设备上。 可以自行导出、导入备份文件，同时会在 iCloud 自动保留一份副本， 换手机或重装 App 后也能恢复。 ■ 一次购买 买一次即可使用全部功能。没有内购、没有订阅、没有广告。

6773321019.name: 毛孩记录机
6773321019.description: 宠物刚看镜头，你却来不及按下快门？ 开心宠物相机把吸引注意、设备端猫狗识别、辅助取景和自动抓拍放进同一个拍摄流程，帮你更从容地记录猫咪和狗狗的自然瞬间。 【宠物一键出片】 开启后置镜头一键出片，App 会在设备端识别猫狗，结合画面稳定、对焦和曝光状态，在条件合适时自动拍摄。多只宠物同框时，可点按识别框锁定想拍的主角。 【声音与动画吸引注意】 提供多种宠物吸引声音；使用前置镜头时，还可播放轻量动画，帮助宠物看向镜头。吸引功能可随时停止，也可关闭声音。 【取景辅助】 支持宠物锁定、自动变焦，以及前置镜头人宠双主体取景，让主体更容易保持在画面中。 【多种拍摄方式】 照片、视频与实况照片 3 秒、5 秒、10 秒倒计时 30 秒连续拍摄 前置屏幕柔光，可调颜色与亮度 【隐私优先】 无需注册或登录，不含广告、统计和第三方跟踪。猫狗识别、取景判断和影像处理均在设备端完成，不上传实时画面或识别结果。获得“仅添加到相册”权限后，作品直接写入系统相册；App 不读取系统相册，也不建立私有图库。 温馨提示： 宠物的反应会因性格、环境和光线而不同。请适度使用声音与动画，并根据宠物状态随时暂停。

6816116794.name: X Guitar
6816116794.description: X Guitar is your private songbook: every chord sheet you play, in one clean format, kept on your device or in your own iCloud. With a tuner you can trust built in. TUNER Pluck a string and it finds the one you meant — or pin a string yourself when one has drifted far out of tune. Tells you which way to turn: tighten or loosen, and which peg, drawn on your headstock. Standard tuning plus Drop D, Open G, DADGAD, half-step down and more, or define your own. Reference tone, adjustable A4, sensitivity for noisy rooms, and a large display you can read from a music stand. Put a capo on and the targets follow. ADDING SHEETS Photograph or import a screenshot or PDF of a chord sheet and X Guitar reads it on your device — no network, no account, no upload. It gives you a draft to check and fix, not a promise of perfection. Paste a link to a page that already has a chord sheet on it and the sheet comes straight in. If you have your own API key for a model provider, you can choose to use it for harder pages. That is entirely optional, always asks first, and sends the image only to the provider you named. CHORD SHEETS Chords sit above the words, where they belong. Chord diagrams for every shape in the song. Change the key to the one you actually sing in — the app then suggests which shapes to play and where to put the capo, preferring shapes you already know. Performance mode scrolls the sheet at your pace, hands free. Search by title, artist, or the opening line of the lyrics. Group songs into setlists for a gig. Your sheets are plain ChordPro files. 6809751320.name: VECTOR BODY
6809751320.description: Your progress is more than a number on the scale. VECTOR BODY brings weight trends, body measurements and progress photos together in a clear, personal record. Whether you are getting leaner, building muscle or maintaining, see how your body changes over time. SEE YOUR WEIGHT TREND Log your weight and follow a smoothed 90-day trend. Daily fluctuations stay visible, while the trend helps you see the direction over time. Add, edit and backdate entries to keep your history accurate. MEASURE MORE OF THE PICTURE Record up to 16 body measurements, including waist, shoulders, chest, hips and left and right limbs. Add your height and a measured body-fat percentage, or use circumference measurements to estimate body fat. View BMI, FFMI and your shoulder-to-waist ratio with explanatory context. KEEP A VISUAL RECORD Save front, side and back progress photos in a dated gallery. Filter by pose and open a photo for a closer look. Take a new photo or choose one from your library. Photos are stored locally on your device. CONNECT WITH APPLE HEALTH Choose to sync weight and height in both directions. Save recorded body-fat percentages and waist measurements to Apple Health. Other tape measurements, progress photos and calculated estimates stay in VECTOR BODY. Sync requires your permission; background timing depends on iOS. MAKE IT YOURS Choose kilograms and centimeters, pounds and inches, or decimal stone and inches. Switch between light, dark and system appearance. Available in English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Dutch, Swedish, Japanese, Korean and Simplified Chinese. LOCAL BY DESIGN Start without creating an account. Your records and photos are stored on your device, with optional sharing of supported measurements through Apple Health. VECTOR BODY does not provide its own cloud backup. Deleting the app may remove local records and photos. BMI, estimated body fat and FFMI are general adult reference tools, not medical advice or a diagnosis. Individual needs and results vary.

6816392935.name: OnlyIdeas
6816392935.description: Read research, ask questions and explore ideas together. OnlyIdeas turns PDFs into flowing text while keeping equations, tables and figures with the paper. Start with real shared research, save papers for offline reading, and keep your private notes nearby. FIND YOUR NEXT PAPER Ask the paper agent to find open research or give it a direct PDF link. Follow up in a saved conversation, read an abstract, then choose Convert & add when you are ready. BRING YOUR OWN RESEARCH Attach PDFs, Word documents, images, Markdown or text files to a conversation and ask about their contents. Agent attachments stay private. Mathpix recognizes text and mathematics; Word conversion keeps embedded equations and figures. Attach up to three files per message. PDF limits are 20 MB and 30 pages, with shared daily allowances. READ AND DISCUSS Use a paragraph's discussion button or select a passage to leave a thought. Personal papers and their discussions stay private. Public contributions are reviewed before sharing with the reading community, with reporting and blocking controls. EXPLORE ACROSS LANGUAGES Use the interface in English, simplified or traditional Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Arabic, Spanish, French, German, Russian or Vietnamese. Follow your device language or choose your own. Request an AI reading guide or paper translation. Readers of the same public paper reuse completed translations. Equations and figures stay with the text. Generated text is labeled and separate from the original; check important claims against the source. YOUR READING SPACE Enjoy a vivid interface with light, dark and system themes. Adjust reading size, open cached papers quickly and keep selected papers offline. Sign in with Apple or GitHub, return to saved conversations and manage your account from Profile. Account deletion is available in the app. Only papers you have the right to share can be published to the public library. Search, conversion, discussions and AI features require an internet connection. Downloaded original papers can be read offline. ON MAC AND APPLE WATCH Read in a native Mac app with sidebar navigation and keyboard shortcuts. From iPhone, send a public paper excerpt to your paired Apple Watch. Keep your latest three excerpts offline, with adjustable text. Full equations and figures stay in the phone and Mac reader. Private papers, chats and account credentials are never sent to Watch.
